description: Record a business outcome (an enrollment, booking, signed engagement, conversion) against this wallet. Outcomes are what the wallet's spend answers to: Sanction computes cost-per-outcome over a rolling window and, when the wallet has a cost_per_outcome ceiling configured, throttles further spend to human-gated once the ceiling is crossed. Call this when your system confirms a real outcome — never speculatively. Use dedupe_key (e.g. your CRM record id) so retries never double-count.

dedupe_key.description: Idempotency key unique per outcome (e.g. CRM record id). Same key = same outcome, never double-counted.

kind.description: Outcome kind in your operating vocabulary, lowercase — e.g. 'enrollment', 'booking', 'signed-engagement'. Must match the policy's outcome_kind for ceiling governance.

play.description: Optional campaign/play label for reporting, e.g. 'speed-to-lead'

value_usd.description: Optional dollar value of the outcome (e.g. expected LTV or contract value) — reporting only, not governance

name: sanction_log_outcome
